events.factual_description: The Public Theater presents the North American premiere of Public Works' PUBLIC RECORD at the revitalized Delacorte Theater in Central Park from September 4 through September 8, 2026, with one performance at 20:00 each night. Based on a concept by Dan Canham and Emily Lim and written by Lisa Sanaye Dring, the production brings more than 100 New Yorkers together with professional musicians, dancers, a DJ, and a vocalist to create a live album onstage in real time. Michael Thurber provides original orchestrations and music supervision. The Public Theater bills Louis Cato, Arturo O’Farrill, Arun Ramamurthy, and Mireya Ramos among the musicians, Papi Juice as DJ, and Maya Margarita as vocalist. The resulting album is to be preserved by the New York Public Library for the Performing Arts. The performances are free, with day-of access distributed through official Public Theater channels including Central Park distribution, an in-person lottery, the TodayTix digital lottery, and a Central Park standby line.

Priority A follows the two-stage editorial decision: the live creation and archival preservation of a city-scale recording with a deliberately broad music cast clears RADAR admission, while the five-night run and absence of a date-specific rare lineup make attend-if-convenient more durable than a stronger behavioral recommendation.

en.why_it_matters: The record is not documentation of the show; making the record is the show. More than 100 New Yorkers share the Delacorte with musicians including Louis Cato, Arturo O’Farrill, Arun Ramamurthy, and Mireya Ramos to build a live album in real time, and the finished artifact is intended for permanent preservation at the New York Public Library for the Performing Arts. That makes this a rare civic-music proposition: the city is being asked to hear itself while the archive is being created.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in the plan between September 5 and 8, this is worth fitting into the evening, and the free five-night run makes it practical to choose the date that works. I would not build a dedicated DMV round trip around it alone.

es.why_it_matters: El disco no es la documentación del espectáculo: hacer el disco es el espectáculo. Más de cien neoyorquinos comparten el Delacorte con músicos como Louis Cato, Arturo O’Farrill, Arun Ramamurthy y Mireya Ramos para construir un álbum en vivo en tiempo real, y ese registro quedará preservado en la New York Public Library for the Performing Arts. Ahí está lo especial: la ciudad intenta escucharse a sí misma mientras crea su propio archivo.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya entra en el plan entre el 5 y el 8 de septiembre, vale la pena acomodarlo en la noche; además, las cinco funciones gratuitas permiten escoger la fecha que mejor embone. No armaría un ida y vuelta dedicado desde el DMV únicamente por esta función.
